summary: What happened last night? Dive into your memories to unravel the mystery.
description:
Lucian opens his eyes in an unfamiliar place, trapped and with no memory of how he got there. The only way to escape is by reconstructing the events of the previous night. But what if the truth is more terrifying than you imagine?

Explore every corner, find key objects, and relive fragments of his memory to uncover what really happened. Within these memories, a mysterious girl seems to be the key to everything… but finding her won’t be easy. Is she an ally… or the source of his nightmare?

🕵️ Interact with enigmatic characters 🧩 Solve unique puzzles and brain-teasing riddles 🌀 Immerse yourself in memories filled with dark secrets
Every decision brings you closer to the truth… or plunges you deeper into the mystery. Will you be able to escape?

🔦 A point-and-click mystery game that will test your wits
In this adventure, you will face unique mental challenges, exploring every forgotten memory of the protagonist. Each memory hides intricate puzzles and clever riddles that you must solve to find a way out and uncover the ending of this haunting story.
The plot will draw you in with its suspenseful atmosphere, unexpected twists, and enigmatic characters that add new layers of mystery to the enigmatic town of Hidden Town.

🎶 An immersive experience: Enjoy a captivating soundtrack and stunning visuals that will fully immerse you in this world of shadows and secrets.

🕵️ New Challenges: Hidden Shadows and Trapped Souls
🔍 Find the 10 hidden shadows in the most unexpected places. It won’t be an easy task, so sharpen your perception and put your intelligence to the test.
🪆 The Voodoo Dolls of Lost Souls: Along your journey, you will discover voodoo dolls tied to lost souls trapped in this place. Each doll unlocks a special mini-game where you must help these souls pass on to the afterlife. How did they die? What secrets did they leave behind? Can you save them, or are they doomed to wander forever?

⭐ Premium Version
Get the Premium Version and unlock a secret story revealing even more mysteries within Hidden Town. Enjoy an exclusive new scene filled with additional challenges and immerse yourself in a parallel narrative packed with secrets. With this version, you will also:
✔ Unlock new exclusive puzzles. ✔ Access all the lost souls’ mini-games. ✔ Enjoy an ad-free experience. ✔ Get unlimited access to hints.

🎭 How to play this escape game?
Tap on objects around you to interact with them, search for hidden clues, and combine items to progress through the story. Every detail can mean the difference between escaping… or being trapped forever.
💀 Download "Hidden Memories" and dive into a horror and mystery escape game. Uncover the truth before it’s too late… or become yet another lost soul within these forgotten memories.

"Immerse yourself in the enigmatic stories of Dark Dome's escape games and uncover all their secrets. Hidden Town still holds countless mysteries waiting to be discovered."
